description.content:
The emnify REST API gives programmatic access to the emnify IoT SuperNetwork — global cellular connectivity for IoT devices. Manage SIMs, endpoints (devices), service and tariff profiles, events, SMS, eSIM (SGP.32) profiles, organizations, users, API callbacks, and the Data Streamer. Authenticate with application tokens or user credentials; tokens are short-lived JWTs.

Source: emnify developer documentation (https://docs.emnify.com/developers/api). This spec is assembled from the per-operation OpenAPI fragments published in the emnify llms-full.txt feed.
